default.model: Default six-word model with per-word distance cutoffs
default.scope: Recorded clips sampled contiguously as the live camera pipeline does; per-word cutoffs calibrated on validation only. Live-camera accuracy unverified.
default.note: 2026-10-17: contiguous sampling, then per-word distance cutoffs calibrated on validation. Model prototypes unchanged; recognizer verified in JavaScript. Earlier runs retained in protocolHistory.

expanded.model: Expanded preview: seven extra words (deployment-faithful frame sampling)
expanded.scope: Recorded clips sampled contiguously over the signing window, as the live camera pipeline does; 11/16 unsupported signs were falsely accepted. Live-camera accuracy unverified. Protocol changed 2026-10-18.
expanded.note: 2026-10-18: frame sampling changed from uniform to contiguous. Two test clips are still untrackable (1 FOOD-class clip and 1 GO clip). Model and parameters unchanged; per-word cutoffs were searched on validation and did not change the test result.

daily.scope: Held-out recorded clips sampled contiguously over the signing window (as the live pipeline captures) with per-word distance cutoffs calibrated on validation only; 3/48 unsupported signs falsely accepted. Live-camera accuracy unverified.
daily.note: 2026-10-18: contiguous sampling (44/66 -> 50/66) then per-word cutoffs (50/66 -> 51/66). Prototypes unchanged; server matcher verified against the scoring implementation.

baby.scope: Untouched ASL Citizen recorded test clips: 8/8 recognized, with zero false accepts among 319 negative clips. Live-camera accuracy remains unverified.
baby.note: 2026-10-21: evaluated on the reserved ASL Citizen test split and verified against the browser scoring implementation.

capstoneFull.scope: Held-out recorded test clips, full 100-word vocabulary and mirror averaging. All reported attempts are counted; clips without sufficient tracking count as misses. This is not the gated core/extended benchmark or live-camera accuracy.

current.model: Full 100-word ST-GCN ensemble · current gated recorded benchmark
current.scope: Current frozen-checkpoint held-out recorded test, using validation-selected rejection gates. All known-word attempts are counted; tracking failures count as misses. Primary Watch reference clips are excluded, and test sources/signers are separate from train/validation. Live-camera accuracy remains unverified. Unsupported signs: 92/689 falsely accepted. Scores are recorded accuracy, not confidence in a camera suggestion.

beginner.scope: Held-out extracted landmark clips for the selected 79-label checkpoint. These scores do not measure a physical live camera; live-camera accuracy remains unverified. Greeting labels are component tests, not complete phrase tests.

GOOD AFTERNOON.note: This benchmark tests the isolated AFTERNOON component labeled GOOD AFTERNOON, not the complete greeting sequence.

GOOD MORNING.note: This benchmark tests the isolated MORNING component labeled GOOD MORNING, not the complete greeting sequence.

GOOD NIGHT.note: This benchmark tests the isolated NIGHT1, NIGHT2 component labeled GOOD NIGHT, not the complete greeting sequence.

current.model: Beginner-79 repaired ST-GCN · current gated recorded benchmark
current.scope: Current frozen-checkpoint held-out recorded test, using validation-selected rejection gates. All known-word attempts are counted; tracking failures count as misses. Scores are recorded accuracy, not confidence in a camera suggestion.

GOOD MORNING.note: These attempts use synthetic joined GOOD + time-of-day recordings, not natural continuous greetings. Natural full-greeting recognition remains unverified.

GOOD AFTERNOON.note: These attempts use synthetic joined GOOD + time-of-day recordings, not natural continuous greetings. Natural full-greeting recognition remains unverified.

GOOD NIGHT.note: These attempts use synthetic joined GOOD + time-of-day recordings, not natural continuous greetings. Natural full-greeting recognition remains unverified.
